newsitem.title: CHINA: Henderson Land sells 103 units in special offer.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land sells 103 units in special offer.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said it sold 103 residential and commercial units worth HK$575 million during a 10-days special offer ended Monday celebrating Hong Kong's reversion to China last week.
"The company made a total HK$575 million from sales of 103 residential and commercial units at the close of the special offer yesterday," a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
The spokeswoman said the company offered a total 138 units, including 20 commerical units, for sale at special prices from June 28 to July 7.
She said no details were immediately available on the number of residential units sold, nor did she have information on the amount of discounts given during the special offer period.
"Property prices will resume normal levels today," she said.

The units on offer were from 15 different residential and commercial development projects in Hong Kong, Kowloon and in the New Territories. Included in the 138 units were four shops, 16 offices and 118 residential units.
Shares of Henderson Land eased HK$0.25 to HK$65.75 in mid-morning.
